title: Rav Ashi bar Avin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Shabbat 66b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.66b.7), Rav Nachman bar Barukh cites Rav Ashi bar Avin in the name of Rav Yehudah. Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Idi bar Avin, as do the Rif and the Rosh. See also [Moed Katan 16a](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.16a.14).[^1]

notes.text: The supplied בא ברוך is read as bar Barukh on the support of the William Davidson digital Shabbat 66b, which fully writes Rav Nachman bar Barukh, Rav Ashi bar Avin and Rav Yehudah. The supplied הרי״ך is interpreted as the Rif; that commentary text has not been independently inspected here.

The complete chain at [Shabbat 66b:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.66b.7) starts with Adda Mari. [Moed Katan 16a:14](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.16a.14) names Rav Idi bar Avin in a separate discussion about lifting a ban. It supplies a comparison for the name without establishing what the other editions read in Shabbat.
